name: Gitea
description: Your own GitHub-style home for code, with issues, reviews and CI

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your repositories, the database (SQLite by default), uploads, LFS files and app.ini with Gitea's own secret keys. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Gitea web pages, API and git over HTTP, published on host as 6795

ports.name: Port 22
ports.description: Git over SSH, published on host as 6796

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: USER_UID
variables.description: The user Gitea keeps your repositories as. It is filled in by MOS.

variables.name: USER_GID
variables.description: The group Gitea keeps your repositories as. It is filled in by MOS.

variables.name: GITEA__server__SSH_PORT
variables.description: The SSH port shown in clone addresses. Keep it the same as the host port for SSH (6796).
